svg.title: Budget board: House of Undunzan
svg.text: Merchant house of the Principality of Chaunde
20 stations. Take them from the top row, left to right.
Your first five cost no upkeep; the last station of each
further row covers its red disc.
Upkeep each round is the highest disc showing.
Start with 10 gold. Outer lane: income; inner lane:
expense; past 50, take a +50 marker. Reach 50 income
(the dark corner) and the game ends.
Below 0 gold after settling: cover the next box. At 0 or
Removing infrastructure moves the marker back down.
Your first commission in a trade opens it: pay 30 gold (20
gold at home) and cover its slot. Hold none in it and it
closes: uncover it; reopening costs again.
